7563.title: Daemon startup after an unclean shutdown
7563.rootCauseOneLine: Original cause unestablished: orphan locks recovered; the launcher prints a lock path for every daemon startup failure.
7563.proposedFix: Capture the contemporaneous macOS child exception, lock mtime and competing processes before selecting a lock fix.
7563.caveats: Linux SIGKILL and old-orphan models repeated in two clean trusted checkouts; actual macOS power loss and desktop launch were unavailable. Test and output embedded inline under reports repository policy.
